params.1273: Talk to a banker in Taverley's bank and deposit some stuff to save space.
params.1274: Head to the bank in Taverley and ask a banker if you can see your bank account.
params.1275: You can also right-click the banker and select 'bank'.
params.1276: Store stuff you want to keep in your bank to save inventory space. The more space you have, the more stuff you can collect.
